name: Grouping
definition: Elements close to each other read as one group. The gap inside a group is smaller than the gap between groups.

measures.measure: gap between groups to gap inside a group

measures.reference: 3 or 5 for an informal group, pairs for a formal group

sources.title: Max Wertheimer, Laws of Organization in Perceptual Forms (1923)
Rudolf Arnheim, Art and Visual Perception: A Psychology of the Creative Eye (University of California Press, 1954; new version 1974)
